name: Pro Refinishing vs Rental Sander in Everett: What Actually Goes Wrong
title-tag: Pro Refinishing vs a Rental Sander in Everett, WA
meta-description: A drum sander can ruin a floor in ten seconds. The real DIY failure modes — stop marks, chatter, edge halo, lap marks — and when DIY genuinely makes sense.
post-summary: April 12, 2027 · A rental drum sander can refinish a floor and can also ruin one in ten seconds, permanently. The failure catalogue from a contractor who gets called to fix them: stop marks, chatter, the edge halo, lost wet edges, and the rag fire nobody expects — plus where DIY genuinely works.
